Spring Mason Bee Mud Box
Arid locations, sandy soil, and rooftop gardens often lack the proper moisture levels to keep mud usable for mason bees.
Product Instructions The Mason Bee Mud Box keeps clay like mud moist in yards with very sandy soil and in arid locations like deserts and rooftop or balcony gardens.
If your mud is too dry for even one day, mason bees will leave your yard and nest elsewhere.
Mason Bee Mud Box: The Original Mud Architects!
Female mason bees are nature's architects, building nest chambers with clay-rich mud to create individual spaces for each developing baby bee.
Each chamber is sealed with a thick mud cap to protect their offspring from predators, ensuring they emerge healthy and ready to pollinate in the spring.
Mason bees won't nest unless a reliable source of clay mud is available within 25 sq.
Why Clay-Mud is Essential: Mason bees prefer mud with a high clay content, similar to modeling clay.
